unbaked.why: PR #237 moves the plugin beneath genesis: the meme-patch slot edit (patchSlotCarrier through meme-put's own gate) and the meme-put row's slot, append and replace answers rebuild the memetic-wikitext bundle. Lares-Alpha's ONE labelled GENESIS RE-BAKE, in its own PR, carries these bytes into the seed and deletes this row. Lane native-wikis moves it again: place-meme takes a vet hook that reads every record an ingest decision would land before the first lands, so meme put refuses a seat-asked startup action (seat-startup-offer) and lands nothing.
